# Bizooma

> AI-powered marketing and development solutions for law firms, nonprofits, and startups in Jacksonville, FL.

Bizooma builds SEO/AEO/Voice SEO programs, AI chatbots, custom websites, mobile apps, and lead-generation systems. We also publish products and tools (NPO Bots, AEO Analyzer, Quickie QR, Signature Pop, Lead Scraper CRM) and run a free SEO/AEO audit.

## Services

- [Law Firm SEO, AEO & Voice SEO](/law-firm-seo-aeo-voiceseo): Search, answer engine, and voice optimization for law firms.
- [Law Firm Digital Marketing](/law-firm-digital-marketing): Full-service marketing for legal practices.
- [Law Firm Lead Generation](/law-firm-lead-generation): Capture and nurture high-quality legal leads.
- [Law Firm Website Development](/law-firm-website-development): Custom law firm websites built to convert.
- [Law Firm Mobile App Development](/law-firm-mobile-app-development): iOS and Android apps for law firms.
- [Law Firm Voice Assistant Marketing](/law-firm-voice-assistant-marketing): Alexa and Google Assistant solutions.
- [AI Consulting for Law Firms](/ai-consulting-for-law-firms): Strategy and implementation of AI tools.
- [AI Customer Support Chatbots](/ai-customer-support-chatbots): 24/7 chatbot support for client engagement.
- [Custom Chatbots](/chatbots): Multi-modal chatbots for any use case.
- [Google Business Profile Optimization](/google-business-profile-optimization): Local search ranking for GBP.
- [Apple Maps Marketing](/apple-maps-marketing): Visibility in Apple Maps and Siri results.
- [Alexa Skills for Law Firms](/alexa-skills-law-firms): Custom Alexa skills.
- [Accessibility Layer](/accessibility-layer): WCAG-compliant accessibility widget for any site.
- [SEO Audit](/seo-audit): Free comprehensive SEO/AEO/Voice audit tool.
